entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Congratulations, Miku. You made it to the finals.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: From here on out, button-mashing panic won't save you. The next trials care more about how well you built your team than how fast your fingers flail.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Prepare extra hard... or don't. Watching you fail here would still be funny.

entries.speaker: Disciple
entries.text: When the light goes out, only your preparation remains.
